name: Ottilie Frayne
background: Former municipal school caretaker who organized the Allotments committee after the Exchange. She manages forty people with minutes, box files, and a calm, quiet voice. She noticed that the reconstruction rating formula removed every water engineer from the surface.

name: Anneke Ruhl
background: The ranking survivor of Ninth Denial Detachment. She operates under an unrescinded pre-war continuity tasking order to deny infrastructure. She holds the detachment's one-time authenticator pad and listens every night for a stand-down order she knows was never transmitted.

name: Corporal Vane
background: Former Iron Garrison supply clerk who deserted during the winter sweeps to save his 11-year-old daughter from an unheated detention barracks. Brings deep knowledge of Garrison supply codes and guard rotations.

name: Sister Martha
background: Fled the Cult of the Ash Sign after refusing to poison communal wells with concentrated radium slurry. Her hands are scarred by ash-burns, but her medical triage skills and quiet presence soothe panicked survivors in dark shelters.

name: Collector Kaelen
background: A pragmatic utility inspector in a heavy rubberized pressure suit. Treats water extraction not as a moral question, but as an engineering ledger that must balance or face catastrophic pump cavitation.

name: Dr. Sarah Chen
background: Carries a lead-shielded surgical kit across the winter wastes, treating acute radiation sickness and deep frostbite across isolated shelters without taking political sides.

name: Signalman Miller
background: A technician who travels on an electric snowmobile, maintaining repeaters and distributing quartz crystal resonators so isolated survivors can hear the Day 340 global broadcast frequencies.

name: Envoy Thorne
background: An officer from the northern civil fleet coordinating the Day 360 icebreaker extraction convoy. Demands clean manifests and coolant supplies, answering to a surviving government across the arctic sea.

name: Tomas Lind
background: University plant researcher who evacuated forty cryogenic seed dewars by hand sled during the first week of ash. Devoted his life to developing frost-resistant root vegetables for bunker greenhouse beds.

name: Valeria Koss
background: Speleologist and structural engineer who designed the deep salt chamber shelters. Understands bedrock mechanics, seismic faults, and foundation fissure sealing better than anyone in the sector.

name: Gunner Mikhail
background: Former garrison gun commander suffering from severe acoustic trauma and tinnitus. Haunted by coordinates he fired during the first winter offensives that struck civilian drainage culverts.

name: Naomi Strand
background: Chemical technician who operated the flash evaporators for the Coastal Authority. Defected after refusing orders to add toxic corrosion inhibitor to downstream civilian tap branches.

name: Pavel Volkov
background: Master heavy diesel technician who can rebuild a seized generator block with a torch, bronze wire, and handmade gaskets. Treats engine noise as a living heartbeat.

name: Zoya Reid
background: Preserved the municipal civil defense card catalog through three bunker fires. Maintains genealogical records, death manifests, and pre-war land registries so survivors know who they are.

name: Captain Alder
background: Veteran arctic ice navigator who piloted the Aurora Borealis through three hundred miles of winter pack ice. Demands unbending naval discipline from anyone seeking passage.

name: Felix Vane
background: Teenager who learned to track mutant game and trap winter ptarmigan in the deforested ash slopes. Quick, silent, and fiercely loyal to the bunker community that took him in.

name: Lydia Hart
background: Senior scientist at the Low-Background Salt Lab. Operating the mass spectrometer in the deep salt formation, she determined the true machine-automated origin of the strike warheads.

name: Igor Morozov
background: Deep-well drilling supervisor who keeps Well Alpha venting clean steam. Lost two toes to frostbite while clearing frozen blow-off valves at forty below zero.

name: Clara Sloan
background: Compounded penicillin and potassium iodide solutions from raw chemical precursors in the Allotments caretaker shed. Kept infant mortality at zero across two harsh winter months.

name: Danek Kroll
background: Former heavy gunner for the Sector 4 Warlords who abandoned his toll station after his commander began executing refugees for barter goods. Cold, cynical, and deadly accurate with a rifle.

name: Helena Blake
background: Specializes in multi-stage electrostatic precipitators and radon scrubbing towers. Can determine filter media saturation simply by listening to the blower motor harmonics.

name: Stefan Nygard
background: Spends sixteen hours a day cutting frozen river peat to feed the masonry kilns and bunker heating stoves. Broad-shouldered, quiet, and immune to cold weather fatigue.

name: Vera Solokov
background: Decoded regional military frequencies from her bunker listening post, documenting every artillery fire mission and troop movement for the historical archives.

name: Erik Dahl
background: Commercial fisherman who survived on the northern sound by harvesting deep-water shellfish. Acts as the primary boatswain and scout for coastal evacuation parties.
